_note: A device type for Settings › Lights › Add a remote-controlled device: a new device file (config/room/rf/<id>.json) starts as a copy of this, with its own name, subsystem and RM4 Pro. A light on an RF remote (room_service/adapters/rf_light.py): the room keeps its own record and presses buttons in order to reach a wanted look (power, colour, brightness steps, then the pulse and flash toggles, gap_s apart). After power at the wall it comes on white at full: Reset (on, white, down x steps, off). Colour ids stay; their names are set when learning.
description: A colour light on a radio remote: on/off, white and six colours, 16 brightness steps, pulse and flash. Several on one remote work as one.
label: Pinspots
